pricingPage.faq1Q: Do I need GPS or special cameras?
pricingPage.faq1A: No. VITAS analyzes any video recorded with a phone. The AI extracts biomechanical metrics from the video, with no additional hardware.
pricingPage.faq2A: Peak Height Velocity (Mirwald). VITAS adjusts the VSI score according to the player's biological maturity so it doesn't compare an early-developing 12-year-old against a late-developing one. No other platform does this.
pricingPage.faq3A: Yes. VITAS complies with GDPR and LOPD Art. 7. Minors under 14 require verified parental consent before processing their data with AI. It includes a DSAR management panel (right of access and erasure).
pricingPage.faq4A: Yes, and VITAS says so. Each evaluation shows its confidence level (High/Medium/Low) and lists which dimensions it could NOT evaluate. In addition, an audit dashboard detects whether the AI favors certain profiles.
pricingPage.faq5A: Yes. The Pro and Club plans include PDF export with metrics, radar chart, tactical analysis and development recommendations.
pricingPage.faq6A: No. Cancel anytime from your billing panel. Your data is kept for 90 days after cancellation.
pricingPage.ctaSubtitle: No credit card. The Free plan includes 3 AI analyses per month.

recordingGuide.title: Recording guide
recordingGuide.dontShowAgain: Don't show again before uploading a video

cameraAngle.title: Camera angle
cameraAngle.good: Record from an elevated position (stands, bleachers, stairs). The higher, the better the tracking.
cameraAngle.bad: Filming from the sideline at field level loses depth and players overlap each other.

distanceFraming.title: Distance and framing
distanceFraming.good: Capture at least half the field. A wide shot where several players can be seen moving.
distanceFraming.bad: Zooming in on a single player prevents calculating position, distance covered, and zones of influence.

stability.title: Stability
stability.good: Rest your phone on something fixed: tripod, railing, backpack. A stable video means accurate data.
stability.bad: Shaky video produces blurry frames that the system discards. Fewer frames means less accuracy.

lighting.title: Lighting
lighting.good: Even natural light, without filming against the sun. Ideal time: morning or afternoon (not midday).
lighting.bad: Backlight or strong shadows on the field reduce player detection by up to 30%.

duration.title: Duration
duration.good: Between 2 and 5 minutes of continuous play. More time means more data means a more reliable evaluation.
duration.bad: Videos shorter than 30 seconds don't generate enough data for a useful evaluation.
